sections.heading: Where it may fit in a shortlist

sections.heading: Questions to ask before buying
sections.body: Ask Zeffy for a workflow-specific demonstration, itemized pricing, implementation responsibilities, data-processing terms, support response targets, and references from organizations with a similar scale and use case.

sections.heading: Our research perspective
